cards.text: Jesus has been teaching the crowds. Now people are bringing little children to Him, so He'll place His hands on them. Here they come, one little one after another.

cards.question: Jesus' disciples see people bringing little children to Him. What do the disciples do?

answers.text: Rebuke the people who brought them
Line the children up for Him
Carry the children to Jesus themselves

cards.text: So the disciples have made themselves Jesus' security team. Velvet rope. Clipboard. Arms crossed. Nobody asked them. Then Jesus sees what they're doing.

cards.question: Jesus sees His disciples rebuking the people who brought the little children. How does He feel about it?

answers.text: Indignant
Amused
Relieved

cards.text: Jesus tells them, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them!” Security team, you are OFF the clock.

cards.question: Jesus gives a reason His disciples shouldn't hinder the little children. Who does He say the kingdom of God belongs to?

answers.text: People like these children
People who keep every rule
People who teach the law

cards.question: Jesus says anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.

answers.text: True
False

cards.question: After Jesus says all this, what does He do with the little children?

answers.text: Takes them in His arms and blesses them
Sends them back out to the crowd
Asks His disciples to bless them

cards.text: Jesus starts on His way, and a man comes RUNNING up. Then he drops to his knees in front of Jesus. Friend, nobody runs AND kneels for small talk. This man has a QUESTION.

cards.question: The man kneels before Jesus and calls Him Good Teacher. What does the man ask Him?

answers.text: What he must do to inherit eternal life
Which commandment is the most important
Where Jesus will be teaching next

cards.text: Before Jesus answers, He asks one of His own: “Why do you call Me good?” Then Jesus says, “No one is good except God alone.”

cards.question: Jesus tells the man he knows the commandments, and lists some of them. Which of these is one Jesus lists?

answers.text: Do not steal
Keep the Sabbath holy
Do not make idols

cards.question: Jesus lists commandments like do not murder and do not steal. What does the man say back?

answers.text: He has kept all of them since his youth
He has broken most of them over the years
He has never been taught all of them

cards.text: Since his youth! Friend, I can't keep my apron clean through ONE batch. But watch this. Jesus looks at him, and loves him.

cards.question: Jesus tells the man there is one thing he lacks. What does Jesus tell him to do?

answers.text: Sell everything and give to the poor
Keep the commandments more carefully
Bring an offering to the temple

cards.text: Jesus tells him he'll have treasure in heaven. Then He says, “Then come, follow Me.”

cards.question: Jesus invites the man to sell everything and follow Him. What does the man do?

answers.text: Goes away in sorrow
Sells it all that same day
Asks for more time to decide

cards.question: The man was saddened by Jesus' words and went away in sorrow, because he had great ___.

answers.text: wealth
debts
doubts

cards.text: The man walks away sad. Jesus looks around at His disciples and says, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!”

cards.question: Jesus tells His disciples how hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God. How do the disciples react?

answers.text: They are amazed at His words
They nod and agree right away
They go after the rich man

cards.text: So Jesus says it again, and this time He calls them Children: “Children, how hard it is to enter the kingdom of God!”

cards.question: Jesus gives a picture of how hard it is for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God. What does He say is easier?

answers.text: A camel passing through the eye of a needle
A boulder floating across the Jordan River
A tower built all the way up to the sky

cards.text: A CAMEL. Through a NEEDLE. Friend, I once tried to squeeze ONE more cookie box onto a full shelf. It did not go. And Jesus is talking about a whole camel! The disciples are even more astonished.

cards.question: The disciples are even more astonished at Jesus' camel picture. What do they ask one another?

answers.text: Who then can be saved
Why did the rich man leave
Must we sell everything too

cards.question: Jesus looks at His astonished disciples and says being saved is impossible with man, but not with ___.

answers.text: God
time
angels

cards.question: Jesus tells His disciples that only some things are possible with God.

answers.text: True
False

cards.text: Then Peter, one of the disciples, speaks up: “Look, we have left everything and followed You.” I bet Peter is wondering where that leaves them.

cards.question: Peter says the disciples left everything to follow Jesus. Jesus says anyone who leaves home or family for His sake and the gospel will receive what in the present age?

answers.text: A hundredfold of what they left
A crown to wear on the last day
Nothing at all until the age to come

cards.question: Jesus promises that people who leave everything for Him will receive a hundredfold with no persecutions.

answers.text: True
False

cards.question: Jesus says the people who leave everything for Him will receive a hundredfold now. What will they receive in the age to come?

answers.text: Eternal life
A new name
Great wealth

cards.text: Then Jesus finishes with one line that flips the whole order upside down. Hold onto your apron, friend.

cards.question: Jesus finishes with a line about who is first and who is last. What does He say?

answers.text: Many who are first will be last
Many who are rich will stay first
Many who are last will stay last
